method.order: Round0 A then B, round1 B then A, alternating through round6 for each route
method.performance_model: Lighthouse mobile simulated Slow4G and 4x CPU
method.resource_delivery: All browser traffic is intercepted to the local fixture, local static assets or exact npm mirrors; unsupported external requests are aborted. URL names are diagnostics, not live-network proof.
method.control_rule: Each of the four unchanged reference routes must have symmetric median LCP ratio <= 1.1 for a reliable local session. No retry or resume is allowed.
method.interpretation: Local simulated evidence only. Not field data, real CDN timing, native hosting proof or a live-speed claim.
